en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a wide river, with several traditional lateen‑rigged sailboats on the water and low buildings along the opposite bank. On the right, a tree and a riverbank wall frame the scene. At the top right are two postage stamps and postmarks. There is handwriting across the lower middle of the image. Printed text at the bottom identifies the view as a site in Egypt associated with the biblical story of Moses.
